title: Habits for multiple times a day?
body: the app is beautiful and simple and well aligned with popular psychology data. I love that’s it’s free and ad free and so aesthetically pleasing. I have a question about the app though. There is a “counting” option (how many times you performed the habit) and a “streak” option (how many days in a row), but I haven’t seen an option for a tracker for habits that require multiple completions a day. You can select a habit as completed, but for example, if the habit requires four executions in a day, you can only mark it as completed once. you can’t mark incremental intra-day completions. Like “on tuesday habit X was completed 3/4 times”. it’s just binary yes or no. Am i missing it or is that just a limitation?
author: Didi Miller02
